main.description: Defines a badge that can be awarded via badge award records to users, projects, or activity claims.

badgeType.description: Category of the badge. Values beyond the known set are permitted.

icon.description: Icon representing the badge, stored as a blob for compact visual display.

description.description: Optional short statement describing what the badge represents.

allowedIssuers.description: Optional allowlist of DIDs allowed to issue this badge. If omitted, anyone may issue it.

extensionTypes.description: Allowed extension payload types for awards of this badge. Each entry is a record NSID (e.g. org.example.goodmarket.approvalMetadata) or a full Lexicon reference for an inline object (e.g. org.example.goodmarket.defs#approvalMetadata). If omitted, no extension type restriction is declared; an empty array allows no extensions. Entries are alternatives, not required payloads. Consumers must validate each extension against its schema and match its payload $type to this list using the definition version referenced by the award. For strong references, check the referenced record's $type, not com.atproto.repo.strongRef. This cross-record constraint is not enforced by Lexicon validation alone.

items.description: A fully qualified Lexicon type identifier: a record NSID or an NSID with a named definition fragment. Compare the exact payload $type; no wildcards or prefix matching.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
